# rea

Reverse engineer anything from your terminal or agent.

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `rea inspect-byte-entropy <path>` | Inspect file-wide and block byte entropy without executing the file |

Run `rea --llms-full` for full manifest. Run `rea <command> --schema` for argument details.
